rationale: The plan matches the reference on every load-bearing point: mMCPcounter as the sole species-matched estimator, explicit refusal of EPIC/quanTIseq/xCell/CIBERSORT and of ortholog or case-based mapping, CPM as the stated TPM surrogate, per-population marker coverage with a 50% flag, scores declared within-population comparable and never fractions, one Wilcoxon per population with BH and effect size, sample_01 retained by default with PCA coloured by condition and depth, and tool versions named. Weaknesses are minor: the Step 1 description of a 'log2(x+1) matrix on the linear scale' is internally muddled even though log2 CPM is what mMCPcounter takes; the DESeq2 reference level is implied by the contrast rather than declared; and the added DE/GSEA corroboration layer is more than the composition question requires, ranks on shrunken LFC rather than a test statistic, and omits gene-set size windows and collection versions. The Step 4 BH family mixing mMCPcounter and signature scores is acknowledged but somewhat dilutes the 'one test per population' structure.
